calibration.note: The score is 0 or 1 and is used as the probability, so ECE equals the Brier score and both measure how often an exact hit is wrong and a miss is right; not a calibrated probability.

exact_v1.definition: accept iff title_exact_norm and artist_full_exact and year_diff in {0, missing}; score in {0, 1} used as the probability; nothing fitted

legacy_threshold_sweep.note: The accept-threshold sweep of the snapshot reused the ambiguity-demotion flag computed at the recorded accept threshold at every swept threshold. For thresholds below the recorded accept_min it can accept records whose top-2 gap is below ambiguity_gap; a faithful replay keeps them in review. Not an arbitrary-policy replay: see legacy_sweep_divergence in the replay bundle metadata.

mapping_exhibit.note: Test-fold decisions in the auto_accept and review tiers only; scores, probabilities and top-2 gaps rounded to six decimals; reject-tier and no-candidate A records are absent. Identifiers, numbers and tiers only.

review_floor.note: Only the review floor moves; accept_min and ambiguity_gap stay at the method's recorded values. Every point is copied from the sensitivity artifact and was computed at the native accept threshold, so only these exported floor values are supported; any other floor is a replay, not a snapshot figure.

calibration.note: Isotonic calibration was fitted on calibrate-fold pairs, so the pair-level error is small; the decision level (top candidate per A record) is overconfident because the maximum of several probabilities is selected.

learned_v1.definition: HistGradientBoostingClassifier on PAIR_FEATURES (class_weight balanced, fixed hyperparameters) trained on fit-fold pairs of labelled A records; isotonic calibration (out_of_bounds clip) fitted on calibrate-fold labelled pairs; calibrated probability drives the tiers

legacy_threshold_sweep.note: The accept-threshold sweep of the snapshot reused the ambiguity-demotion flag computed at the recorded accept threshold at every swept threshold. For thresholds below the recorded accept_min it can accept records whose top-2 gap is below ambiguity_gap; a faithful replay keeps them in review. Not an arbitrary-policy replay: see legacy_sweep_divergence in the replay bundle metadata.

Every point is copied from the sensitivity artifact and was computed at the native accept threshold, so only these exported floor values are supported; any other floor is a replay, not a snapshot figure.

calibration.note: The raw weighted score is used as the probability without calibration; the pair-level error shows what an uncalibrated score looks like and is not comparable with a calibrated probability.

rules_v1.definition: score = 0.45*title_token_set + 0.35*artist_token_set + 0.20*year_agreement, year_agreement = 1 if year_diff == 0, 0.5 if 1, 0.25 if missing, else 0; weights fixed a priori; t_accept maximises F1 over labelled fit-fold A-record decisions, t_review is the score below which their cumulative precision falls under 0.50; raw score used as the probability (uncalibrated)

legacy_threshold_sweep.note: The accept-threshold sweep of the snapshot reused the ambiguity-demotion flag computed at the recorded accept threshold at every swept threshold. For thresholds below the recorded accept_min it can accept records whose top-2 gap is below ambiguity_gap; a faithful replay keeps them in review. Not an arbitrary-policy replay: see legacy_sweep_divergence in the replay bundle metadata.

review_floor.note: Only the review floor moves; accept_min and ambiguity_gap stay at the method's recorded values. Every point is copied from the sensitivity artifact and was computed at the native accept threshold, so only these exported floor values are supported; any other floor is a replay, not a snapshot figure.

coverage.definition: Auto-accepted A records over every test-fold A record, labelled or not, including records with no candidate. A volume measure, not an accuracy measure.

decision_level_brier.definition: Mean squared error of the top candidate's probability against its correctness.
decision_level_brier.scope: labelled test-fold A records, top candidate

decision_level_ece.definition: The same calibration error over the top candidate of each labelled test-fold A record. Different from the pair level by construction: choosing the maximum selects overconfident probabilities, so a pair-calibrated model is overconfident at decision level.
decision_level_ece.scope: labelled test-fold A records, top candidate

decisions_moved_to_review.definition: Test-fold A records at or above accept_min whose top-2 gap is below ambiguity_gap and which therefore sit in review instead of auto_accept.
decisions_moved_to_review.numerator: test-fold A records demoted from auto_accept to review

f1.definition: Harmonic mean of precision and recall_labelled, computed from the six-decimal rounded values as the evaluator does. No numerator or denominator of its own.

f1_or_review.definition: Harmonic mean of precision_or_review and recall_labelled_or_review.
f1_or_review.display_name: F1 if every review resolves correctly

pair_completeness_test.definition: Labelled test-fold A records whose truth survived blocking over all labelled test-fold A records: the ceiling blocking puts on recall for every method.
pair_completeness_test.numerator: labelled A records with a truth pair among their candidates

pair_level_brier.definition: Mean squared error of the probability against the pair label.

pair_level_ece.definition: Expected calibration error over every labelled test-fold candidate pair: ten equal-width probability bins, count-weighted mean absolute gap between the mean probability and the observed match rate. rules_v1 uses an uncalibrated score as its probability, exact_v1 a binary score; learned_v1 is calibrated at this level.

precision.definition: Among labelled test-fold A records the method auto-accepted, the share whose accepted B is in the A record's truth set.
precision.scope: labelled test-fold A records, auto_accept tier

precision_or_review.definition: Upper bound: a review row counts as correct when any of its candidates is in the truth set. Over labelled records in auto_accept or review.
precision_or_review.denominator: labelled A records in auto_accept or review
precision_or_review.display_name: Precision if every review resolves correctly
precision_or_review.numerator: correct auto-accepts plus queued labelled A records with reachable truth
precision_or_review.scope: labelled test-fold A records, auto_accept and review tiers

recall_labelled.definition: Correct auto-accepts over labelled A records whose truth survived blocking. Unlinked is not non-match: nothing is known about unlabelled records.
recall_labelled.denominator: labelled A records with a truth pair among their candidates

recall_labelled_or_review.definition: Upper bound: correct auto-accepts plus queued labelled records whose truth is among the candidates, over labelled records whose truth survived blocking.
recall_labelled_or_review.denominator: labelled A records with a truth pair among their candidates
recall_labelled_or_review.display_name: Recall if every review resolves correctly
recall_labelled_or_review.numerator: correct auto-accepts plus queued labelled A records with reachable truth

recall_overall.definition: Correct auto-accepts over all labelled A records; equals recall_labelled times pair_completeness_test.

review_queue.definition: Test-fold A records in the review tier at the recorded policy: records queued by value plus records the ambiguity rule moved from auto_accept.
review_queue.numerator: test-fold A records in the review tier

unverified_accepts.definition: Auto-accepts on unlabelled test-fold A records.

unverified_accepts_share.definition: Auto-accepts on unlabelled A records over all test-fold auto-accepts. Counted by coverage, invisible to precision and recall.

provenance.note: Every value above is copied from the committed artifact named by its source_key; counts read from a mapping exhibit are asserted against the artifact's own ratio before writing. No curated case contributes to any figure.
